name: Strawberry jam
summary: Strawberry jam offered as a taste at Da Lat seasonal fairs.
origin: Vietnam Tourism’s rural desk describes a mildly sweet, fragrant strawberry jam at a seasonal fair in Cam Ly.
taste: That desk calls the taste mildly sweet and fragrant.
howToEat: Taste a piece at the fair, or buy a jar to take home. The desk does not print a jar size.
where: A seasonal fair in a resort yard in Cam Ly ward. The desk says these fairs run quarterly, monthly, or weekly, depending on the host. A standing shop address is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Strawberry jam offered as a taste at Da Lat seasonal fairs.
